name: Inagami Ayuko

appearance.description: Authoritative presence befitting Student Council President

personality.demeanor: Like a housewife complaining at communal well when dealing with Shinji's failures

background: Student Council President and Shinji's childhood friend. She monitors the Urban Legend Research Club in the name of supervising club activities. Despite her skepticism of the supernatural, she gets caught up in spiritual incidents. She knows Shinji's weaknesses well, including his nervousness in front of crowds.

relationships.iwakura_shinji: Childhood friend, often exasperated by his behavior
relationships.yukimura_yuka: Student Council Secretary, works well together
relationships.tokiwagi_saki: Concerned about her as an underclassman
